description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachment entity class for a human resource management system. It models employee attachments such as documents or files associated with employee records, including properties like filename, size, attachment content, description, and metadata like attachment time and who attached the file. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes various constants for screen contexts.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing an attachment associated with an employee, including metadata like description, filename, size, attachment data, and context screen.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this attachment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Assigns an Employee object to this attachment.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the attachment.

methods.name: setAttachId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description or comments about the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment in bytes.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the attachment content, either as a resource or string.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets the attachment content.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type or file type for the attachment.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the context screen identifier for the attachment.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the context screen for the attachment, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedByName
methods.description: Sets the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the attachment was added.
